title: Instant page changes
description: A new page, tabs, a card and full width: each one item-tool call, shown live.

add.text:
**Every change on this page was one call.** An agent made it with the item tool, and an open tab redrew within about a second, with no reload.

| You did | The call (on `page`) | Here |
|---|---|---|
| made this page | `demos.pages.add({name: "instant", title: "Instant page changes"})` | this page |
| went full width | `page.set({width: "full"})` | this page is full width |
| added a card | `page.content.add({type: "part-card", title, text})` | the card below |
| added tabs | `page.pages.add({name: "one"})`, then `page.pages.add({name: "two"})` | the tabs **One** and **Two** |

Under `/live/`, a sub-page with no children of its own shows as a tab, so two `pages.add` calls are two tabs. Plan: [/live/plan/plugins/](/live/plan/plugins/).

add.title: This card was one call
add.text: `page.content.add({type: "part-card", title: "This card was one call", text: "…"})`. Change it the same way: `page.card.set({text: "new text"})`.

what.text:
**Every change on this page was one call or two.** An agent made it with the item tool, and an open tab redrew within about a second, with no reload.

| You did | The call (on `page`) | Works under /live/? |
|---|---|---|
| made this page | `demos.pages.add({name: "instant", title: "Instant page changes"})` | yes: this page |
| added a card | `page.content.add({type: "part-card", title, text})` | yes: the card below |
| added tabs | `page.pages.add({name: "one"})`, then `page.tab({name: "one", tab: true})`; the same for two | yes: the tabs One and Two above |
| went full width | `page.set({width: "full"})` | **not yet**: the word is saved, but this page stays reading width. It works on a plain page, and the fold plan makes /live/ pages plain Pages. |

Why a tab takes a second call: under /live/, a sub-page is a link card unless its parent marks it a tab. Plan: [/live/plan/plugins/](/live/plan/plugins/).
